products.product_description: Whole Foods Smoked Peppered Atlantic Salmon Portion, packed in bulk boxes. Labeling states: Smoked on: 08/09/17, Sell Through: 09/04/17. Smoked fish portions are placed inside of a box lined with a plastic bag, which is hand-tied when the box is filled. Weights of each box vary.
products.reason_for_recall: Rushing Waters Fisheries is recalling 3 smoked fish products because they may have been underprocessed.
